meta.dtype: f32 (values are exact: JSON numbers are the shortest f64 repr of each f32)

what: PLE: n-gram hash rows (shift-right-ignore-eos over raw ids), 16-head analog table gather, signed-sqrt gate (with HF's |s|>=1e-6 clamp), per-stream sigmoid gating of the shared value, and the dilated depthwise conv residual.

config.eos_note: tiny analog of 248044; segments reset AT eos, shift never crosses it

hash_case.what: host-side hash standalone: no cache -> history padded with [eos, eos] (position-0 padding); eos at positions 2 and 7 exercises segment resets.
hash_case.row_indices_note: [seq, 4 heads]: heads 0-1 are 2-gram, heads 2-3 are 3-gram; row = (t0*m0 ^ t1*m1 (^ t2*m2)) mod head_vocab + head_offset, over raw ids, i64

layer_case.what: full PLE layer forward, no cache, eos at position 5
layer_case.output_note: caller adds this to the hyper-connection stream BEFORE the attn HC read

gate_function_probe.what: exact scalar gate map s -> sigmoid(sign(s)*sqrt(max(|s|,1e-6))) (modular line 770; HF DOES clamp at this commit)

tolerance_note: hash rows and shifts are exact integers (must match exactly); float tensors: suggested tolerance max(1e-6, 10 * matching f64_delta floor), elementwise abs.
